geographicLimits.conclusion: The official PDF is a panoramic relief schematic without accepted page georeferencing. Its curves are faithful in document pixels only. Current EPSG:4326 lines come from complete, ordered OSM ways attributed by explicit names/IDs, not from the PDF. Name/sector correspondence and separate published distances do not certify identical path extent, shape or current access. No global affine/geographic registration or endpoint interpolation can be justified by the retained material.
